meta.title: Make `set_len` a tokio-epoll-uring operation
meta.body_summary: Add ftruncate operation to tokio-epoll-uring library and update set_len to use it, aiming to improve I/O performance; PR closed after maintainer noted failure with multi-repo handling.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted to implement async set_len via uring operation but failed with multiple commits; maintainer closed due to inability to handle multi-repo PRs.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 83 changed lines, this is a tiny I/O engine patch. It fits a small, focused performance optimization but was closed because the agent could not deliver a working cross-repo implementation.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer probame stated 'You had it right initially, but apparently can't deal correctly with multi repo PRs.' indicating that initial commits were correct but later changes broke the implementation due to cross-repo coordination issues.
review_details.performance_claim: Make set_len asynchronous via tokio-epoll-uring to avoid blocking I/O.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR immediately after observing multi-repo handling failure; no performance evidence was requested or provided.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cross-repository change coordination (adding an operation in one repo’s extension and using it in another) exceeded the agent's ability; iterative self-commits led to a broken implementation.

detection_detail.code_reading: probame reviewed the PR commits and identified that the initial approach was correct but later changes were erroneous; commented and closed without requiring benchmarks or CI.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No working implementation or benchmark was produced; the agent’s final commits returned an error, indicating failure to deliver the claimed performance improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by probame with no follow‑up fix; the agent’s inability to handle the multi‑repo aspect led to immediate rejection.

core_change_summary.description: Attempt to add ftruncate operation to the tokio‑epoll‑uring handle and replace the synchronous set_len call with it. Multiple iterative commits eventually reverted to returning an error for ftruncate, leaving the change non‑functional.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: modify io_engine.rs to call new ftruncate operation on set_len.
Add ftruncate method to tokio_epoll_uring_ext Handle struct.
Iterative fixes: import Deref, adjust implementation, fallback to standard file ops, fix trait bounds and error types.
Final commits: remove unused imports, return error for ftruncate (effectively abandoning the optimisation).

review_signals.summary: Standard Devin bot introduction with auto‑comment and CI monitoring for write‑access users.
Maintainer stated initial approach was correct but agent cannot handle multi‑repo PRs; closed the PR immediately.
Automatic comment noting no tests were run and test coverage unavailable.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial implementation and multiple self‑commits in rapid succession (all by Devin bot).
No formal reviews; maintainer probame commented on the failure ~31 minutes after creation and closed the PR.
